body: Thanks to everyone who had the courage to vote for change over entrenchment, hope over fear, diversity over homogeneity, and reconciliation over division. So many people have put their skin in the game and worked hard to make this moment possible. This is good news for our country and a good moment for our world. There is much to be done, but we have begun an important journey. May all Americans celebrate this historic moment. May a new day begin. May God help us make the most of this moment.
